hints.title: Symmetry Orbit Partition
hints.text: Under dual horizontal and vertical symmetry, non-central cells partition into quadruplets that must all match and naturally contribute zero or four ones.

hints.title: Quadruplet Minimization
hints.text: For each four-cell orbit, flip the minority bit value to the majority bit value adding min(ones, 4 - ones) to the flip count.

hints.title: Odd Middle Axes and Modulo Four
hints.text: Center lines pair up into 2-cell orbits. Mismatches provide flexible resolution to ensure total ones is divisible by four; if zero mismatches exist and one-pairs are odd, two flips are required.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass aggregating disjoint symmetry orbits.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exhaustive search on binary grid cells explodes exponentially.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Decomposes grid into 4-cell orbits, 2-cell boundary axes, and center cell with modulo 4 parity control.
